Context: 3. Reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWSs)

10. Grievance Redressal Officer.Every Government establishment shall appoint a senior officer of the Department as the Grievance Redressal Officer. The name, designation and contact details of the Grievance Redressal Officer may be displayed prominently on the website and in the office of the concerned establishment.
11. Liaison Officer.A Liaison Officer may be appointed to monitor the implementation of reservation for EWSs.  
- Orders 1 and 2, Section 4 and OM, dated 19-9-2022.
